searchText: How do I dump my staked eth before the price plummets further? You cannot. Staking is indefinite until withdraws are implemented. This should have been made explicitly clear to you during the setup process (e.g., launchpad.ethereum.org went to great lengths to make this clear to users). Wait I can't sell the thing I own? Correct. Once you stake you are locked in until withdraws are implemented, and then your turn in the withdraw queue comes up. If you gave your money to someone else (like a custodial exchange) and *they* then staked it, you may be able to ask them to pay out early (possibly at a discount) since you have an IOU with them, and you aren't actually a staker. Ok this js helpful info thank you Why is there a queue?
